text.description_html:
Pemko 210DV36 Door Shoe

Door shoes are used to seal the area under a door with minimal affect on the appearance of the face of the door. In addition to sealing the gap under the door, door shoes are often used to provide protection for the bottom of the door. Pemko door shoes consist of an aluminum channel with a flexible Eco-V insert.

Specifications for Pemko 210DV Door Bottom:

  • Finish: Dark Anodized
  • Insert: Black
  • Material: Aluminum Alloy and Temper Retainer
  • Total Height with Insert: 1-9/16"
  • Width: 1-1/4"
  • Length: 36"

Special ordred item. No Returns
